summary: Workspace is well-organized with minimal hazards, noting an exposed electrical cord near baseboard.

hazards.title: Trailing Floor Cable
hazards.detail: Cable runs down wall to floor near desk base, posing minor snag risk.
fixSteps: Secure the dangling wire along the baseboard or back of desk.
Use adhesive cable clips to keep cords elevated off floor.

hazards.title: Unsecured Wall Cord
hazards.detail: Exposed black power cord plugged near skirting board could be damaged.
fixSteps: Inspect cord jacket for pinch damage from the desk or chair.
Bundle and secure slack behind the desk panel.

products.name: Self-Adhesive Cable Clips
products.reason: Secures loose power cords against the desk leg or baseboard.
